description: Source code for the TextToSpeech plugin implementation in the WPEFramework, providing APIs for TTS functionalities such as enable, list voices, configure, speak, and control speech states.

classes.name: TextToSpeech
classes.description: Implementation of the TTS plugin providing API methods for TTS control and configuration.

methods.name: enabletts
methods.description: Enables or disables TTS based on input parameter.

methods.name: listvoices
methods.description: Lists available TTS voices for a specified language.

methods.name: setttsconfiguration
methods.description: Sets TTS configuration parameters such as endpoint, language, voice, volume, and rate.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Initiates speech synthesis for the provided text.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing speech for a given speech ID.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses speech for a given speech ID.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes paused speech for a given speech ID.

methods.name: isspeaking
methods.description: Checks if the TTS engine is currently speaking for a given speech ID.

methods.name: getspeechstate
methods.description: Retrieves the current speech state for a given speech ID.
